description: This file contains SwiftUI views and associated components for rendering chat messages in a chat interface, including message bubbles, tool call cards, typing indicators, and message content rendering with styling and customization.

classes.name: ChatBubbleShape
classes.description: Custom shape for chat bubbles with optional tails and insets.

classes.name: ChatMessageBubble
classes.description: Main view for displaying a chat message bubble, styled differently for user or assistant messages.

classes.name: ChatMessageBody
classes.description: Sub-view responsible for rendering the content inside a message bubble, including text, attachments, tool calls, and tool results.

classes.name: AttachmentRow
classes.description: View representing a row for a file attachment in a message.

classes.name: ToolCallCard
classes.description: View showing details of a tool call within a message.

classes.name: ToolResultCard
classes.description: View presenting the result of a tool execution, with toggle to show more or less content.

classes.name: ChatTypingIndicatorBubble
classes.description: View indicating that the assistant is typing, with animated dots.

classes.name: ChatStreamingAssistantBubble
classes.description: View for displaying ongoing assistant reply with markdown rendering.

classes.name: ChatPendingToolsBubble
classes.description: View displaying the status of pending tool executions.

classes.name: ChatAssistantTextBody
classes.description: Rendering of assistant message content with markdown and thinking indicators.

methods.name: inset
methods.description: Returns a copy of the shape inset by the specified amount.

methods.name: path
methods.description: Generates the drawing path for the chat bubble shape based on tail position.

methods.name: body
methods.description: SwiftUI view body for each main component, rendering the message or indicator.

methods.name: updateAnimationState
methods.description: Controls animation state of typing indicator dots based on scene and motion settings.
